correctness.rationale: Each endomorphism is a unique nilpotent cubic substitution. The centralizer histograms sum to q^3 and their first moments give pair counts. The separate finite-field checker exhaustively agrees over q=2,3,4,5,7,8,9, but is not used to infer infinitely many cases.

value.rationale: The full composition-centralizer spectrum and center of a natural finite algebra endomorphism monoid are intrinsic structural invariants. Cubic jets are the first length where the nonlinear coefficient interaction 2buv affects the classification. The exact odd/even characteristic bifurcation, the exceptional resonance c=-b^2, and center jumps at q=2,3 provide meaningful structure across all finite fields, beyond a routine single number or isolated small-field computation.
